A private speedboat from Koh Samui reaches Haad Rin or Ban Tai on Koh Phangan in about 20–25 minutes and Thong Nai Pan in 45–50 minutes, leaving when you want rather than on a ferry timetable and landing at beaches the ferries don't serve. Prices start at 8,500 THB per boat for up to 4 guests to Haad Rin or Ban Tai, and from 10,000 THB for up to 10. Send us your date, time, group size, luggage and beach on WhatsApp; we quote the total, and you pay by secure link in THB.

Good to know: prices on this page were checked on 2 November 2026. The sea decides the route: the captain may land at the nearest sheltered pier instead of a beach when waves are up, mostly from October to December.

For a couple with light bags going to Thong Sala, the ferry is the sensible choice: every operator, pier and timetable is on our Koh Samui to Koh Phangan guide. The private boat makes sense for groups, families with luggage, late flights, villas on beaches with poor road access and anyone who values their time.

Popular uses

Villa-to-villa transfer

Phangan's best villas and resorts are often on the east and north coasts, where the road from Thong Sala is long and hilly and some beaches have no road at all. A private boat takes you from the pier near the Big Buddha to the beach in front of your villa when the sea is calm: Haad Yuan and Haad Tien on the east coast, Thong Nai Pan in the north-east, Bottle Beach in the north, or Wok Tum and Hin Kong on the west. Beach landings can mean stepping into knee-deep water, so pack phones and documents in a dry bag.

Koh Phangan day trip

A private boat for the day lets you see the parts of Phangan the ferries never reach: snorkelling at Koh Ma, the beaches of Thong Nai Pan, Bottle Beach and the Than Sadet coast. We sell several private boats for a Phangan day, all priced per boat:

Hotel transfers, extra guests and inclusions differ by boat; each product page shows the details, and all can be booked and paid online. Than Sadet and the east coast are best reached by sea from about February to September, when the north-east monsoon has eased; landings there depend on swell. Plan your beach stops with our sister site's guides to Koh Phangan's beaches and Than Sadet.

Full Moon and Half Moon nights

On party nights the crossing is busy and the public boats are packed, so most groups book a dedicated party boat rather than a transfer:

  • Full Moon Party private speedboat: your own boat for up to 10, 19,500 THB one way or 35,800 THB return at your times, with hotel pickup and drop-off on Samui.
  • Full Moon Party shared speedboat: 1,400 THB per person return, door to door from most areas of Koh Samui.
  • Half Moon Festival package: from 2,700 THB per person on Magic Forest nights.

We sell the boat transfers, not Full Moon Party entry, which is about 200 THB at the gate. Next party: [kp_next_party] Dates and planning: Full Moon Party from Koh Samui and Full Moon Party dates.

Airport connections

Samui's airport is about 15 minutes from the pier near the Big Buddha, which makes a private boat the fastest way from a flight to a Phangan beach. Our driver meets you at arrivals, tracking your flight, and takes you to the boat; the van costs 1,000–1,500 THB extra. Flights landing after 17:30 and pickups before 08:00 carry a 1,500 THB early or late fee, because the crossing runs outside normal hours. On the way back, plan to land on Samui at least 2–3 hours before your flight. More on the airport: Koh Samui airport.

Our boats

Transfers run on private twin- or three-engine speedboats with a captain and crew, sized for up to 10 guests with luggage. Twin- and triple-engine boats are faster and more comfortable in chop than single-engine boats, and in rough water we can swap to a larger boat. For groups of more than 10, weddings and corporate groups, we quote a bigger speedboat from our charter fleet; our larger boats carry up to 28 or 37 guests. See all our private speedboat charters and the wider Koh Samui boat charter guide.

How booking works

  1. Step 1 Message us on WhatsApp with your date, preferred time, number of adults and children, luggage, and your hotel on Samui and on Phangan (or the beach you want).
  2. Step 2 We check the boat, the route and the sea forecast, and send a written quote with the total in THB, including any van, luggage or time-of-day fees.
  3. Step 3 You pay by secure payment link. Prices are charged in THB; EUR and USD are shown for reference only.
  4. Step 4 We confirm by email or WhatsApp with the pier, the captain's contact and pickup details.
  5. Day of travel The driver or captain contacts you; if the sea changes, the captain chooses the safest landing.

Good to know

  • Sea state: from October to December the north-east monsoon brings swell to Phangan's east coast and some days rough water across the strait. We sail only when it is safe, may use a larger boat, and may land at a sheltered pier instead of a beach. Check sea conditions or Windy before you plan.
  • Night crossings: possible on request, but they depend on the sea and the captain's decision, and early or late fees apply. On Full Moon nights, book a party boat instead.
  • Luggage: one large suitcase per person is included; extra bags cost 200 THB each. Soft bags are easier to pass from boat to beach than hard cases.
  • Beach landings: expect to step into shallow water; wear sandals and keep valuables in a dry bag.
  • Children: children's life jackets are provided and must be worn at all times on board.
  • Seasickness: sit towards the back of the boat, where the motion is gentlest, and take tablets before you board if you are prone to it.
  • Return trips: book the return when you book the outward crossing if you have a flight to catch, and leave a weather buffer before international flights.
  • High season: boats book up around Christmas, New Year and Full Moon nights; a 700 THB supplement applies from 20 December 2026 to 20 January 2027.

Is it cheaper than the ferry? For 10 people, the ferry costs about 3,500 THB in fares plus taxis on both islands and the time spent waiting at piers, compared with 10,000 THB for the private boat to Haad Rin or Ban Tai. For a group with luggage, or for anyone heading to a beach without a ferry pier, the difference is smaller than it looks. Need help planning the whole trip? Cancellation

  • 4 days or more before travel: full refund, minus the bank fee.
  • 1–3 days before travel: 50% refund.
  • Within 24 hours, or no-show: no refund.
  • Weather and sea safety: if the crossing is cancelled because the sea isn't safe, you choose a new date or a full refund.
